    tennis_player_patches = image_patch.find("tennis player")
    
    if not woman_patches or not tennis_player_patches:

    woman_patch = woman_patches[woman_centers.index(closest_woman)]
    tennis_player_patch = tennis_player_patches[tennis_player_centers.index(closest_tennis_player)]
    
    return tennis_player_patch

    # Check if the lady is on the end based on the vertical distance

    return closest_item

    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    main_patches = image_patch.find("main")
    kilt_patches = image_patch.find("kilt")
    if not main_patches: return image_patch
    if not kilt_patches: return main_patches[0]
    kilt_depth = kilt_patches[0].compute_depth()
    in_kilt = [m for m in main_patches if m.compute_depth() < kilt_depth]
    return in_kilt[0] if in_kilt else main_patches[0]

modern_c2_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    car_patches = image_patch.find("car")
    
    if not person_patches or not car_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    person_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in person_patches]
    car_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in car_patches]
    
    closest_person = min(person_centers)
    closest_car = min(car_centers)
    
    if closest_person < closest_car:
        return person_patches[person_centers.index(closest_person)]
    else:
        return car_patches[car_centers.index(closest_car)]
